      finiteFunctional (frameWeight F s) (frameAtom F) f = momentLawFunctional F s f

def FreeEvaluationStatement : Prop :=

      productFunctional D.status
        (fun a => MvPolynomial.eval (fun z => a z.1 z.2) (freePolynomial D pairs))
